WITH yearly_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE("Disbursement Date", 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS loan_year,
    SUM("Loan Amount (Rs)") AS total_amount
  FROM "shg_loan_register"
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE("Disbursement Date", 'YYYY-MM-DD')) IN (2023, 2024)
  GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE("Disbursement Date", 'YYYY-MM-DD'))
),
comparison AS (
  SELECT 
    MAX(CASE WHEN loan_year = 2024 THEN total_amount END) AS amount_2024,
    MAX(CASE WHEN loan_year = 2023 THEN total_amount END) AS amount_2023
  FROM yearly_totals
)
SELECT 
  (amount_2024 - amount_2023) * 100.0 / NULLIF(amount_2023, 0) AS percent_difference
FROM comparison;
